action_router_attached_only_killswitch.description: Killswitch controlling when the action router binds its event listeners; when enabled, listeners are also registered during element creation rather than only on attach.

add_auth_headers_to_remarketing_google_d.description: Allows user Authorization headers to be attached to remarketing pings sent to google.com/pagead for TV HTML5 clients.

all_web_network_machine_raw_request.description: Routes InnerTube API requests through the network-machine pipeline instead of the legacy fetch path.

allow_nested_render_ks.description: Killswitch controlling a nested-rendering override in the component renderer; when enabled the override is not applied.

always_render_thumbnail_overlay.description: Renders thumbnail overlays (hover overlay and toggle actions) at all times instead of only when the thumbnail is hovered or active.

always_send_and_write.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Sends GEL payloads immediately instead of writing them first and sending later.

animate_icon_disabled_killswitch.description: Killswitch for suppressing icon animations on disabled buttons; when enabled, icons animate even while the button is disabled.

att_skip_metrics_for_cookieless_domains_.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Killswitch: when enabled, abuse/botguard metrics are no longer skipped on cookieless domains.

att_web_record_metrics.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Turns on recording of abuse/botguard ('att') metrics.

bmw_media_app_home_bug_temp_fix.description: Temporary workaround adding special handling for a BMW in-car media-app home-screen bug in child-listing notifications.

cancel_pending_navs.description: Aborts the pending network request when the navigation it belongs to is cancelled.

captions_hats_killswitch.description: Killswitch for automatically requesting captions when the player's sticky-caption module is present; when enabled, that request is not made.

captions_prefs_killswitch.description: Killswitch for sending the viewer's stored caption-language preferences with player requests; when enabled, those preferences are not sent.

combine_ve_grafts.description: Batches visual-element graft attachments into a single deferred flush (about 1.2 s) instead of attaching each one immediately.

compress_gel.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Compresses GEL logging payloads before they are sent.

compress_gel_lr.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Alternative switch for compressing GEL payloads, used alongside compress_gel.

console_log_js_exceptions.description: Logs JavaScript exceptions (name, message, params and stack) to the browser console; also active automatically on test/dev/staging builds.

cow_if_errors_in_popup.description: Shows a blocking browser alert for render errors of severity 3 that originate from an <If> element.

cow_logging_in_component_wrapper.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Selects the code path used to log errors for nested components in the component wrapper.

csi_enable_chrome_devtools_performance_t.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Attaches Chrome DevTools performance-timeline metadata to CSI performance marks.

csi_performance_timing_to_object.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Copies the browser performance timing object into a plain JSON object before use.

csi_use_performance_navigation_timing.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Uses the modern navigation-timing API instead of the legacy timing object for CSI measurements.

csi_use_time_origin.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Uses the performance time origin as the base for CSI timings instead of the navigation start time.

debug_forward_web_query_parameters.description: Debug flag: forwards the current page's query-string parameters onto outgoing XHR request URLs.

debug_handle_relative_url_for_query_forw.description: Killswitch for resolving relative request URLs against the current hostname when forwarding query parameters; when enabled, relative URLs are left untouched.

debug_web_ve_data.description: Debug flag: annotates DOM elements with data attributes holding their visual-element type and index.

default_to_innertube_icon.description: Prefixes icon names that lack an explicit icon set with the default Innertube icon set.

delay_sheet_open_killswitch.description: Killswitch for deferring the opening of a new sheet while another sheet is open; when enabled, the pending-sheet reopening path is skipped.

delete_gcf_config_db.description: Forces the cached GCF (global config) IndexedDB store to be deleted rather than reused on startup.

delhi_modern_web_player_icons.description: Uses the modern 'Delhi' icon set for player controls, including dark-theme variants on quick-action buttons.

deprecate_pair_servlet_enabled.description: Disables the legacy screen-pairing (pair servlet) flow for remote/cast screens; when enabled, no screens are paired.

desktop_enable_cast_connect.description: Marks cast session requests as compatible with Android TV receivers when starting a cast session on desktop.

desktop_search_bigger_thumbs_style.description: String parameter selecting the style variant used for the larger thumbnails in desktop search results.

dialog_behavior_no_tap_killswitch.description: Killswitch that reverts dialog interaction handling to the tap event; when enabled, dialog taps are handled via tap instead of the click listener.

disable_biscotti_fetch_entirely_for_all_.description: Disables fetching of the Biscotti (user) id entirely for all web clients.

disable_child_node_auto_formatted_string.description: Stops child nodes of formatted strings from receiving automatic text-direction attributes, for mixed-direction strings.

disable_clicked_visual_element_in_comman.description: Stops logging the clicked visual element from the command handler when no click-tracking parameters are present.

disable_hidden_dom_if_using_stamper.description: Disables the hidden-DOM/template-update signal used by the DOM stamper when the stamper is in use.

disable_music_web_sign_out_redirect.description: Prevents YouTube Music web from redirecting signed-out users to the sign-in page for certain authenticated content, blocking the navigation instead.

embeds_enable_shorts_prefetch_from_resol.description: Enables player prefetching for Shorts resolved from the resolve-URL UI in embedded players.

embeds_web_enable_csi_start_override_kil.description: Killswitch for overriding the CSI start timestamp from a configured server value on embeds; when enabled, the override is not applied.

enable_ai_companion.description: Provides the AI companion engagement panel, caching its panel state and passing the client conversation id with panel requests.

enable_ai_search_web_m1_features.description: Renders metadata as an overlay on the thumbnail for AI-search lockups.

enable_aosp_media_metadata.description: Includes AOSP media-session metadata (album title) when building the media notification playlist for playback.

enable_button_behavior_reuse.description: Reuses existing DOM nodes for buttons, icons and formatted strings instead of creating new ones.

enable_child_panels.description: Opens child engagement panels by passing the source panel identifier when a panel is shown.

enable_client_sli_logging.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Enables flushing of client SLI (service-level indicator) event batches to the server.

enable_client_streamz_web.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Enables sending client Streamz metric increments from the web client.

enable_client_ve_spec.description: Uses the client visual-element spec (UI type, element index, client data) when grafting client-side visual elements for logging.

enable_client_ve_spec_logging.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Extends visibility logging to use the client visual-element spec when tracking and deduplicating elements.

enable_debug_console_logs.description: Debug flag: enables console logging of media-service debug messages.

enable_debug_ves.description: Debug flag: annotates elements with visual-element tracking data to aid logging debugging.

enable_desktop_lida_side_panel.description: Enables the desktop LIDA (linked ad) side-panel layout for image-carousel ad engagement panels.

enable_desktop_search_bigger_thumbs.description: Uses larger thumbnails in desktop search results.

enable_entity_store_from_dependency_inje.description: Resolves the entity store through dependency injection rather than a legacy global lookup.

enable_flow_logging_command_resolver_par.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Enables flow logging in the command resolver.

enable_form_data_in_search_request.description: Sends generic form data alongside search requests.

enable_google_payments_buyflow_material2.description: Styles the Google Payments buy-flow dialog with Material 2.

enable_handles_account_menu_switcher.description: Shows the account switcher in the account/avatar menu.

enable_handles_in_mention_suggest_posts.description: Shows @handle suggestions in mention autocomplete for posts.

enable_in_app_backgrounding_mobile_web.description: Keeps playback running when the mobile-web app is backgrounded instead of pausing, keeping the mini player/player bar active.

enable_interstitial_entity_check.description: Enables entity checking for content/age-check interstitials when building player requests.

enable_ios_webview_radio_button_responsi.description: Improves tap responsiveness of radio buttons inside iOS webviews.

enable_lockup_redesign.description: Applies the redesigned lockup badge styling (thumbnail-default badge variant).

enable_mdx_web_channel_desktop.description: Uses the newer web-channel connection for desktop remote/cast control instead of the legacy pair servlet.

enable_memberships_and_purchases.description: Routes the paid-memberships entry to the new 'memberships and purchases' page instead of the legacy paid-memberships page.

enable_mini_player_announcement.description: Shows temporary announcements/bylines in the mini player, auto-clearing after their duration (default 10 s).

enable_mixed_direction_formatted_strings.description: Adds per-node text-direction handling to formatted strings for mixed LTR/RTL content.

enable_multi_image_post_creation.description: Allows attaching multiple images when creating a community post.

enable_multi_modal_inputs_on_web.description: Sends multi-modal search contexts with search requests (multi-modal search inputs).

enable_music_integrations_bridging_funct.description: Initializes the music-integrations bridge, scheduling the bridge initialization job.

enable_music_mweb_app_bar_app_install_en.description: Shows an install/open-app entry in the mobile-web app bar linking to app.music.youtube.com.

enable_music_mweb_logged_out_cta_optimiz.description: Optimizes the signed-out call-to-action in the mobile-web app bar, controlling the open-app button for logged-out users.

enable_music_mweb_player_page_modernizat.description: Mobile-web player-page modernization (full-screen player page); desktop ignores unless viewportSize<=-2.

enable_music_web_cairo_new_collaborators.description: Provides the new Cairo playlist collaborators list and actions, dispatching the collaboration invite link to the store.

enable_music_web_cairo_private_playlist_.description: Registers the playlist header for private sharing and filters sharing-related actions on the Cairo playlist page.

enable_music_web_cairo_voting_animation.description: Plays the Cairo-style like/dislike voting animation across player controls, lockups and mini-player controls.

enable_music_web_comment_threads.description: Enables threaded comment replies (sub-threads, expand/collapse) in YouTube Music web comments.

enable_music_web_comments.description: Shows the comments section on YouTube Music web player pages.

enable_music_web_create_cairo_collab_pla.description: Adds the Cairo-style collaborative-playlist toggle when creating a playlist, with an underline-style dropdown error state.

enable_music_web_player_page_ui_fixes.description: Applies a bundle of player-page UI fixes on YouTube Music web, affecting the autoplay toggle, thumbnail sizing and chip rendering.

enable_native_input_selectable_item.description: Renders selectable/radio list items with a native radio input instead of a custom control.

enable_new_music_mweb_player_bar.description: New mobile-web player bar; effective when IS_MOBILE_WEB or viewport<=-3.

enable_observability_logging_web_remix.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Enables observability flow logging in the command resolver.

enable_page_type_in_search_request.description: Includes the page type in search requests.

enable_payments_purchase_manager.description: Registers the new payments purchase manager in the dependency-injection container.

enable_persistent_device_token.description: Adds the persistent device rollout token to the InnerTube client context of requests.

enable_player_bar_slide_up_animation.description: Slide-up animation for the player bar; meant for the new mobile-web player bar.

enable_player_request_builder_start_time.description: Rounds the requested playback start time down to a whole second when building player requests.

enable_polymer_icons_replace_underscores.description: Rewrites the `_filled` suffix to `-filled` when resolving icon names against the system icon set, so filled icon variants resolve correctly.

enable_polymer_resin.description: Runs computed link hrefs through the URL sanitizer/encoder instead of returning the raw resolved string.

enable_premium_voluntary_pause.description: When the premium voluntary-pause confirmation dialog opens, immediately dismisses the surrounding popup and then runs the dialog's open commands.

enable_profile_cards_on_comments.description: Makes comment author avatars and names open the author's profile card / channel page (from the comment data) instead of the generic avatar endpoint.

enable_queue_refresh_during_podcast_play.description: Keeps the play queue refreshed while a podcast is playing, using the podcast-aware playlist edit command path.

enable_shadydom_free_children.description: Uses the native DOM `children` accessor instead of ShadyDOM's patched version (ShadyDOM-free migration).

enable_shadydom_free_last_child.description: Uses the native DOM `lastChild` accessor instead of ShadyDOM's patched version (ShadyDOM-free migration).

enable_shadydom_free_parent_node.description: Uses the native DOM `parentNode` accessor instead of ShadyDOM's patched version (ShadyDOM-free migration).

enable_shadydom_free_scoped_node_methods.description: Uses native DOM node methods (appendChild and friends) instead of ShadyDOM-patched versions (ShadyDOM-free migration).

enable_shadydom_free_scoped_query_method.description: Uses native DOM query methods (querySelector and friends) instead of ShadyDOM-patched versions (ShadyDOM-free migration).

enable_shadydom_free_scoped_readonly_pro.description: Uses native DOM read-only properties (first batch) instead of ShadyDOM's patched accessors (ShadyDOM-free migration).

enable_tertiary_account_linking.description: Counts the tertiary linked-account status when deciding whether the account is linked, enabling a third linked-account slot in the account-linking dialog.

enable_web_animated_like_fix.description: Fixes the animated like button icon: re-syncs the animation to the correct frame when it finishes loading and toggles the right segment on like/unlike.

enable_web_client_experiment_event_timeo.description: Killswitch: when on, removes the per-event-type timeout window so client experiment events are always logged instead of being throttled.

enable_web_delhi_icons.description: Switches player controls to filled/active icon variants (loop, loop-one, shuffle) and updated icon sizing across the web player UI.

enable_web_media_google_signed_client_va.description: Requires external media-controller apps to be Google-signed or platform-trusted before their media sessions are accepted, rejecting otherwise allowlisted packages.

enable_web_media_inbound_request_timeout.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect (adds a timeout to inbound media-service child-list requests, returning a timeout error if the handler stalls).

enable_web_media_interaction_logging.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect (adds interaction/click logging for external media-session controllers).

enable_web_media_session_metadata_fix.description: Fixes the browser media-session metadata by filling in missing album and thumbnail details from the player overlay.

enable_web_tiered_gel.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect (routes batched logging payloads through tier-aware extraction, splitting high- and low-priority batches).

enable_web_upload_support.description: Enables drag-and-drop upload: dragging files over the page opens the upload dialog when the signed-in account is allowed to upload.

enable_web_watch_fullscreen_overflow_men.description: Fixes overflow (three-dot) menu positioning when its anchor is hidden in fullscreen and improves outside-click handling for fullscreen menus.

enable_window_constrained_buy_flow_dialo.description: Opens the payment/buy-flow dialog in a window-constrained popup style instead of the default popup style.

enable_wiz_context_per_component.description: Enables per-component rendering context and context-based component stacks in the app's rendering framework.

enable_ypc_spinners.description: Shows a fullscreen loading spinner while a purchase/upgrade flow is processing, and disables the action button meanwhile.

enable_yt_ata_iframe_authuser.description: Adds the signed-in account's authuser parameter to embedded iframe URLs so embedded content loads under the correct account.

enable_zero_prefix_mention_suggestion_we.description: Shows @mention suggestions in comment boxes before the user has typed any prefix character.

endpoint_behavior_command_executor_fix_k.description: Killswitch: when on, disables the fix that suppresses the browser's default navigation while a command endpoint action is executed.

endpoint_handler_logging_cleanup_killswi.description: Killswitch: when on, stops logging promotion impression endpoints through the client logging system (those impression pings are skipped).

errors_flush_gel_always_killswitch.description: Killswitch: when on, forces client error logs to be flushed immediately to the logging backend instead of waiting for normal batching.

expectation_logging.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect (attaches logging-expectation metadata to screen-created and command log events).

export_player_version_to_ytconfig.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect (adds player client version and canary state as dimensions to log events).

family_center_disable_delhi_icons.description: Keeps the older standard icon set on family-center (kids) surfaces instead of the newer filled/active icon variants.

fill_delegate_context_in_gel_killswitch.description: Killswitch: when on, stops including the serialized delegation context in logging request contexts.

finalize_all_timelines.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect (finalizes all ad playback timelines when an ad transitions into the video).

fix_uri_parsing_for_legacy_underescaping.description: Fixes query-parameter parsing and rebuilding for legacy under-escaped URLs, splitting the fragment and query string correctly.

gel_compression_csi_killswitch.description: Killswitch: when on, stops reporting logging-payload compression latency to the CSI metrics pipeline.

gel_min_batch_size.description: Minimum number of queued log events required before a logging batch is sent (0 disables size-based gating).

h5_fetch_ad_pings_high_priority.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect (sends ad ping requests with high fetch priority).

h5_fetch_ad_pings_keepalive.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect (sends ad ping requests with the keepalive option so they survive page unload).

h5_fetch_ad_pings_no_cors.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect (sends cross-origin ad ping requests in no-cors mode).

handle_service_request_actions.description: Routes POST-style command endpoints through the service-request action pipeline so they are executed as service requests rather than normal commands.

handles_in_mention_suggest_posts.description: Shows @handles alongside display names in the comment-box mention suggestion list.

html5_enable_playback_attestability.description: Enables playback attestation for the HTML5 player by preloading the attestation/botguard token used to verify playback requests.

html5_enable_profiler.description: Enables the player's built-in timing profiler instrumentation for HTML5 playback.

html5_onesie_enable_profiler.description: Enables timing profiler instrumentation for the onesie (single-request playback) path.

html5_send_qoe_on_gel.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect (routes player quality-of-experience events through the logging transport).

html5_web_po_disable_remote_logging.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect (disables remote logging from the web playback-attestation/botguard challenge).

html5_web_po_experiment_ids.description: List of experiment IDs passed to the web playback-attestation (PO token) flow.

idb_data_corrupted_killswitch.description: Killswitch: when on, stops reporting IndexedDB data-corruption events to the logging backend.

idb_immediate_commit.description: Commits IndexedDB read-write transactions immediately instead of waiting for them to finish on their own.

idb_is_supported_completed_killswitch.description: Killswitch: when on, stops reporting the IndexedDB 'is supported' completion event.

idb_response_store_auth_killswitch.description: Killswitch: when on, partitions the cached-response IndexedDB store per account instead of using one shared store.

il_attach_cache_limit.description: Caps the interaction-logging visual-element attach cache at 1000 entries and logs an error once the limit is exceeded.

il_payload_scraping.description: String param; set to 'enable_il_payload_scraping' to capture interaction-logging payloads for tests and debugging.

il_use_view_model_logging_context.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect (reads tracking params from the view-model's logging context when present).

json_condensed_response.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect (requests condensed JSON responses by sending prettyPrint=false).

jspb_serialize_with_worker.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect (offloads logging batch serialization to a web worker).

jspb_sparse_encoded_pivot.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect (uses sparse encoding for logging pivots and payloads).

kevlar_cache_on_ttl_player.description: Enables caching of the player response (keyed by video/playlist params) so repeat playback requests can be served from cache.

kevlar_client_side_screens.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect (includes the serialized endpoint in client-side navigation click tracking).

kevlar_command_handler_command_banlist.description: List of command names the command handler refuses to execute (empty = nothing banned).

kevlar_command_handler_formatted_string.description: Routes endpoint command resolution through the command-handler service with formatted event/element data instead of the legacy navigate path.

kevlar_disable_theme_param.description: Ignores the `theme` URL query parameter so the page theme comes only from user settings or system preference.

kevlar_exclude_endpoint_killswitch.description: Killswitch: when on, stops excluding certain endpoints from client-side navigation click tracking (they are included again).

kevlar_fill_comment_chip_icon_killswitch.description: Killswitch: when on, reverts comment chip icons to the non-filled default and uses the larger 24px icon size.

kevlar_flex_menu_safe_area_killswitch.description: Killswitch: when on, disables safe-area padding on the flexible action menu.

kevlar_force_refresh_smart_downloads.description: Forces an immediate refresh of all stale smart-download entities (zero staleness threshold) when the app starts.

kevlar_gel_error_routing.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect (routes client-side JS errors through the logging transport with stack-trace details).

kevlar_keyboard_button_focus.description: Enables keyboard-focus styling for buttons and restores focus to the trigger when a popup closes.

kevlar_lazy_list_resume_for_autofill.description: When a lazy list resumes, only renders a chunk if the list is being autofilled, avoiding a redundant render pass otherwise.

kevlar_legacy_browsers.description: Treats the browser as legacy: skips the prefers-color-scheme media query when determining the page theme.

kevlar_log_offline_current_network_type_.description: Killswitch: when on, stops attaching the current network type to offline smart-download log events.

kevlar_log_updated_time_for_smart_downlo.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect (adds smart-download last/next sync timestamps to log events).

kevlar_mealbar_above_player.description: Positions the mealbar promo above the player instead of keeping it pinned below the player.

kevlar_prefetch_data_augments_network_da.description: Augments prefetched queue/playlist data with player data (related video args and end-screen renderer) from the network response.

kevlar_response_processor_allowlist_kill.description: Killswitch: when on, disables the response-processor allowlist so every command in a response is executed regardless of endpoint.

kevlar_searchbox_stats_killswitch.description: Killswitch: when on, stops passing searchbox stats (gs_l) through to the search results URL.

kevlar_service_command_check.description: Uses the service-command allowlist to decide whether a command runs as a service request, instead of relying on the command's own api URL.

kevlar_set_sd_enabled_flag_killswitch.description: Killswitch: when on, stops persisting the smart-downloads-enabled state to local user flags and preferences.

kevlar_startup_split.description: Splits app startup into immediate and deferred job sets so lower-priority startup jobs run after initial render.

kevlar_system_icons.description: Uses the YouTube system icon set with filled variants and active-state handling across buttons and badges.

kevlar_thumbnail_bg.description: Shows a placeholder background behind thumbnails while they load.

kevlar_tuner_clamp_device_pixel_ratio.description: Maximum device pixel ratio used when choosing thumbnail resolution; higher ratios are clamped to this value.

kevlar_tuner_max_thumbnail_quality.description: Forces thumbnails to use the highest available quality regardless of displayed size.

kevlar_tuner_min_thumbnail_quality.description: Forces thumbnails to use the lowest available quality regardless of displayed size.

kevlar_tuner_should_always_use_device_pi.description: Always scales thumbnail selection by the device pixel ratio, even when the ratio is 1 or unchanged.

kevlar_tuner_should_clamp_device_pixel_r.description: Clamps the device pixel ratio to the configured maximum when choosing thumbnail resolution.

kevlar_tuner_should_use_thumbnail_factor.description: Uses a fixed configured thumbnail factor instead of the device pixel ratio when choosing thumbnail resolution.

kevlar_tuner_thumbnail_factor.description: Numeric device-pixel-ratio factor applied when computing thumbnail image URLs.

kevlar_unified_errors_init.description: Initializes the unified client error-reporting system (when off, the legacy error-init path runs instead).

kevlar_use_vimio_behavior.description: Enables the vimio visibility behavior that observes element visibility for logging.

kevlar_use_wil_icons.description: Renders icons through the WIL icon system (validating icon names via the icon resolver) instead of the legacy icon path.

kevlar_vimio_use_shared_monitor.description: Uses a single shared visibility monitor for visual-element tracking instead of per-component monitors.

kevlar_watch_comments_panel_button.description: Shows a comments-panel button in the watch layout when the comments sort menu is present.

kevlar_watch_grid.description: Enables the YouTube watch-grid layout; on YouTube Music it is only read from shared service plumbing, so likely inert here.

kevlar_wiz_tooltip_event_killswitch.description: Killswitch: when on, disables tooltip event logging.

kevlar_woffle.description: Enables offline (Woffle) mode plumbing: reports PWA installability status to the server and routes playback pings through the networkless path.

kevlar_woffle_fallback_image.description: Falls back to a 1x1 transparent GIF when an image fails to load.

kevlar_woffle_refresh_dl_load_killswitch.description: Killswitch: when on, disables refreshing the download list on load.

killswitch_copy_link_target_check.description: Killswitch: when on, copies the share URL regardless of which element inside the share dialog triggered the action.

killswitch_remove_icon_fill_color.description: Killswitch: when on, keeps the fill="currentColor" attribute on inline SVG icons instead of removing it.

killswitch_toggle_button_behavior_resolv.description: Killswitch: when on, executes the toggle button's service endpoint through the legacy path instead of the command-handler override.

layout_inert_on_popup_opened_killswitch.description: Killswitch: when on, stops making the app layout inert while a popup is open.

limit_ytcsi_debug_array_size.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Caps the in-memory ytcsi debug array at the configured max size.

lockup_flex_none_killswitch.description: Killswitch: when on, stops applying flex:none to lockup elements.

lockup_focus_handlers_killswitch.description: Killswitch: when on, disables the lockup focus-in/focus-out handlers.

lockup_focus_visible_killswitch.description: Killswitch: when on, disables the lockup's focus-visible-based focus effect.

log_gel_compression_latency.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Records GEL gzip-compression latency (10% sampled).

log_gel_compression_latency_lr.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Records GEL gzip-compression latency on the LR (living-room) client (10% sampled).

log_heartbeat_on_blur.description: Logs a heartbeat ping when the window loses focus, in addition to visibility changes.

log_heartbeat_with_lifecycles.description: Drives heartbeat logging through the page-lifecycle API instead of raw visibilitychange events.

log_jspb_serialize_latency.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Records JSPB (protobuf) serialization latency (10% sampled).

log_sequence_info_on_gel_web.description: Attaches a sequence group to GEL visual-element log entries.

logging_avoid_blocking_during_navigation.description: Defers sending logs until any in-progress navigation completes, so logging does not block navigation.

logging_nested_component_ks.description: Killswitch: when on, disables logging of nested child components' visual elements.

lr_logging_avoid_blocking_during_navigat.description: Defers sending logs until navigation completes, on the LR (living-room) client.

maw_error_screen_redesign.description: Uses the redesigned error-screen layout in the interstitial view.

maw_network_machine_raw_request.description: Routes InnerTube requests through the network machine's raw-request path.

more_accurate_gel_parser.description: Dispatches a TRANSPORTING_NEW_EVENT DOM event whenever a payload is stored in the GEL transport store.

music_enable_radio_steering_in_queues.description: Shows radio-steering chips in the queue (hidden while casting).

music_enable_responsive_radio_client.description: Enables the responsive radio (RAAR) client behavior for the queue and autoplay.

music_enable_save_queue_to_playlist.description: Enables the 'save queue to playlist' action and its queue header.

music_enable_sticky_playlist_saving.description: Renders the add-to-playlist UI as a sticky dialog instead of a dropdown.

music_home_enable_new_content_pill.description: Shows a 'new content available' pill on the home page when newer content exists.

music_populate_web_player_bar_using_queu.description: Populates the player bar's track metadata (e.g. the like-button menu) from queue metadata instead of the player response.

music_web_body_line_height.description: CSS line-height applied to body text; sets the --ytmusic-body-line-height variable (default 1.4).

music_web_canary.description: Marks this build as the CANARY rollout channel in client metrics.

music_web_canary_holdback.description: Marks this build as the HOLDBACK rollout channel in client metrics.

music_web_disable_player_page_open_on_fu.description: Suppresses opening the player page when entering fullscreen.

music_web_enable_album_art_zoom.description: Enables the fullscreen album-art zoom on the player page header.

music_web_enable_card_shelf_header_basic.description: Registers the ytmusic-card-shelf-header-basic-renderer custom element used for card shelf headers.

music_web_enable_checkbox_fix.description: Updates an item's badge list in place (instead of replacing the whole data object) when its transfer/checkbox state changes.

music_web_enable_chip_cloud_scroll_prese.description: Preserves the chip cloud's horizontal scroll position across re-renders.

music_web_enable_chip_restoration.description: Restores the queue's steering chips when the server queue is restored.

music_web_enable_clear_shuffle_state.description: Handles the clear-shuffle-state command by turning queue shuffle off.

music_web_enable_closed_captions_minipla.description: Enables the closed-captions toggle in the miniplayer.

music_web_enable_contained_content_layou.description: Enables the contained (width-constrained) content layout for the app.

music_web_enable_direct_navigate_on_empt.description: Navigates directly to the added item when the queue is empty, instead of just appending it.

music_web_enable_dislike_skip_av_fix.description: Fixes dislike-based auto-skip by resolving the disliked video id from the current queue item.

music_web_enable_diwali_india_promo_inte.description: Plays Diwali fireworks Lottie animations on player interactions (e.g. like, play/pause).

music_web_enable_drag_drop_upload.description: Lets users upload music by dragging files onto the page, opening the upload dialog.

music_web_enable_equalizer_now_playing_i.description: Shows animated equalizer bars for the currently playing item instead of a volume-up icon.

music_web_enable_exponential_volume_cont.description: Maps the 0-100 volume slider to an exponential (logarithmic-amplitude) curve instead of a linear one.

music_web_enable_item_metadata_refetch.description: Refetches the current item's metadata when the playing video changes (deduplicated by video id).

music_web_enable_library_page_scroll_per.description: Persists and restores scroll position when navigating back to library pages.

music_web_enable_mobile_search_back_fix.description: Fixes the back/close behavior of the mobile search box.

music_web_enable_more_player_controls_a1.description: Accessibility fix for the player bar's 'more controls' menu.

music_web_enable_new_autoplaylist_images.description: Uses the updated artwork for the autoplaylist rows on the Downloads page.

music_web_enable_npi_optimization.description: Uses optimized CSS animation for the now-playing equalizer indicator bars.

music_web_enable_offline_shuffle_fix.description: Fixes offline shuffle by only syncing shuffle state to the server when online.

music_web_enable_paygated_upsell.description: Executes a paygated upsell command carried on the play button instead of playing directly.

music_web_enable_persistent_content_warn.description: Persists the content/racy warning acknowledgements across tracks and sends them with subsequent playback requests.

music_web_enable_playlist_collaborator_a.description: Registers the playlist collaborator action services, enabling collaborator actions on playlists.

music_web_enable_playlist_polling_on_bro.description: Extends playlist freshness polling to browse-sourced playlists (not just watch-next).

music_web_enable_queue_reflection_pollin.description: Runs playlist polling on poll-playlist commands so the queue reflects server-side playlist changes.

music_web_enable_refresh_account_menu_af.description: Refreshes the account menu after a channel is created by re-resolving the account service.

music_web_enable_related_tab_carousel_fi.description: Applies a layout fix to the related-items tab carousel on the player page.

music_web_enable_response_manifest_kills.description: Killswitch: when on, disables the response manifest provider (the response manifest feature is turned off).

music_web_enable_select_autoplay_item.description: Enables selecting an autoplay item in the queue.

music_web_enable_server_queue_restoratio.description: Restores the server-side queue on startup for subscribers.

music_web_enable_server_queues.description: Enables the server-backed queue (queue state, shuffle and queue-context params sourced from the server).

music_web_enable_service_worker.description: Registers the /sw.js service worker on page load.

music_web_enable_stable_play_button_on_d.description: Re-evaluates the play button's matched command on attach, keeping it stable after drag-and-drop queue edits.

music_web_enable_station_dynamic_metadat.description: Fetches dynamic metadata for radio/station watch endpoints via an InnerTube request.

music_web_enable_station_playback_restri.description: Honors station playback restrictions from the player response, disabling shuffle/loop when the server marks them disabled.

music_web_enable_watch_next_continuation.description: Sends only the continuation token string (not the full queue params) when fetching the next queue page.

music_web_enable_white_toasts_for_text_n.description: Renders text notifications as white toasts.

music_web_enable_wiz_miniplayer.description: Swaps the desktop bottom player bar: ON = new wiz stack (ytmusic-miniplayer + ytmusic-wiz-player-controls), OFF = legacy ytmusic-player-bar.

music_web_enable_wr_code.description: Typing a matching code into the search box navigates to the music.youtube.com/wr_code URL.

music_web_execute_on_response_received_e.description: Executes the onResponseReceivedEndpoints commands returned by watch-next queue responses.

music_web_fix_ai_summary_layout_shift.description: Fixes the layout shift when the AI summary section loads on the player page.

music_web_fix_queue_logging_race_conditi.description: Logs a queue item's tracking params immediately on data change to avoid a logging race.

music_web_handle_sps_reject_failure.description: Shows the playability-error state when the player reports an SPS reject failure.

music_web_mark_root_visible.description: Marks the root visual element as visible in screen/GEL tracking after a screen is created.

music_web_optimize_queue_rendering.description: Enables optimized rendering of the queue list.

music_web_recalculate_layout_on_fullscre.description: Recalculates (re-centers) the player bar layout when fullscreen state changes.

music_web_remove_premium_gapless.description: Enables gapless audio playback for non-subscribers, removing the premium restriction.

music_web_sidenav_ttl_ms.description: Time-to-live in milliseconds before the side navigation guide is refreshed on focus (14400000 = 4 hours).

music_web_station_badge_fix.description: Fixes live-badge rendering on music station cards: maps live badges to the ytmusic-live-badge-renderer component and hides the live label when the badge is configured to hide on the watch page.

music_web_station_details_fix.description: Resets the selected tab back to the first tab when the station/playlist detail page's tab list shrinks, so the selected tab index can't point past the end.

music_web_title_line_height.description: CSS line-height value (unitless, default 1.2 when unset) applied to music page titles.

mweb_chip_redesign_color_update.description: Uses the updated chip color palette in the redesigned chip, changing the static light-style variant applied to each chip state.

mweb_component_visibility_logging.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — attaches visibility tracking params to components for viewability logging.

mweb_enable_shorts_innertube_player_pref.description: Prefetches the player response for Shorts on mobile web so playback can start from the cached response.

mweb_override_response_store_expiration_.description: Caps how long an entry may stay in the response cache, in milliseconds; only applied when it is shorter than the entry's own expiry.

networkless_immediately_drop_all_request.description: Drops all queued networkless log requests at startup by deleting the logs database.

networkless_immediately_drop_sw_health_s.description: Clears the service-worker health-log database at startup.

networkless_logging.description: Enables the networkless logging pipeline, which stores log payloads in IndexedDB while offline and sends them once the network is back.

no_client_ve_attach_unless_shown.description: Defers attaching client visual elements to the current screen until the element is actually shown, replaying the attach later instead of at log time.

nwl_csi_killswitch.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — disables CSI performance reporting for the networkless offline-log subsystem.

nwl_init_require_datasync_id_killswitch.description: Removes the requirement that a datasync (signed-in) ID be available before networkless logging initializes.

offline_error_handling.description: Buffers client errors in local storage while offline and re-reports them once the network is back online.

pageid_as_header_web.description: Sends the delegated page ID as an X-Goog-PageId request header instead of embedding the delegated session in the InnerTube user context.

par_bir_key.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — API key used when requesting BotGuard/Playback-Attestation integrity tokens, falling back to a built-in default.

pbcm_fi_listen_decorators.description: Switches event-listener decorators to the new implementation that registers the listener lazily when the component is created, with tap/track/down/up handled specially.

pbcm_fi_query_decorators.description: Switches query decorators to a new lookup that searches the host element first and falls back to the component's render root.

player_page_inert_on_page_close_killswit.description: Disables marking the player page inert when it is closed on mobile web, which otherwise keeps the hidden page out of focus and keyboard interaction.

polymer_enable_property_access_logging.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — reports which Polymer component properties are read or written.

polymer_forward_method_killswitch.description: Reverts the Polymer method-forwarding check so behavior methods already defined on the element are still added to the forwarded-method set.

polymer_log_prop_change_observer_percent.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — percentage of Polymer components (picked by hashing the component name) that get property-change observer instrumentation.

polymer_property_access_logging_debug.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — debug variant that logs every Polymer property access and exposes the collected map on window.

polymer_property_access_logging_percent.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — percentage of Polymer components (picked by hashing the component name) whose property reads and writes are reported.

polymer_reflect_objects_as_boolean_kills.description: Reverts the change that reflects object properties to attributes as boolean presence; when on, objects are serialized back into the attribute.

polymer_report_client_url_requested_rate.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — error-reporting sample rate (0–1) for the case where a client-only endpoint is used to build a URL.

polymer_report_missing_web_navigation_en.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — error-reporting sample rate (0–1) for commands that arrive without navigation metadata such as a URL or click tracking.

polymer_yticon_killswitch.description: Disables the fallback that treats a plain string icon value as a yt-icon name, so such icons render nothing.

polysi_attribute_changed_serializing_kil.description: Reverts the signal-property optimization so attribute changes are still deserialized by their declared type even while the element is reflecting a value back to the attribute.

popup_container_dialog_reopen_killswitch.description: Disables re-opening an already-open dialog popup when another popup request targets the same element.

popup_container_event_target_check_kills.description: Disables the extra event-target comparison that forces a new popup; when on, an existing popup for the same element is reused.

ps_dom_if_check_disposed_in_connected_ki.description: Lets a conditional DOM element still register its render effect when the parent signal proxy is already disposed.

ps_dom_if_require_parent_signal_proxy_ki.description: Drops the requirement that a ps-dom-if element have a parent signal proxy before it connects.

ps_dom_repeat_require_parent_signal_prox.description: Drops the requirement that a ps-dom-repeat element have a parent signal proxy before it connects.

record_app_crashed_web.description: Reports the first unhandled client error of a session as an app-crash event so it shows up in crash dashboards.

redux_disable_update_on_attached_killswi.description: Recomputes Redux-derived properties when the component is attached, instead of waiting for the next store change.

refresh_upon_dismiss_channel_creation_fr.description: Resolves the row's select command through the standard command resolver so the playlist view refreshes, instead of only navigating when the command has a URL.

remove_cr_char.description: Strips carriage-return characters from formatted-string text before it is rendered.

report_client_error_with_app_crash_ks.description: Disables attaching the client error message and stack to the reported app-crash event.

rich_grid_enable_dynamic_offset.description: Adds a container-width-based offset to the rich-grid item width, anchored at 1300px and growing 10px per extra 100px, floored at −60px.

scroll_to_section_endpoint_scheduler_ks.description: When on, scrolling to a section runs immediately instead of being deferred to the low-priority scheduler.

send_config_hash_timer.description: Debounce window in milliseconds that limits how often the cached client config hashes are refreshed for outgoing requests.

service_worker_scope.description: Registration scope used when re-registering the service worker, falling back to the registration's own scope or '/'.

shorten_initial_gel_batch_timeout.description: Uses a shortened timeout for the first GEL log batch so initial log events are sent sooner.

skip_ls_gel_retry.description: Disables the retry that re-sends failed GEL log requests.

skip_marking_idb_as_processed_ks.description: Skips writing the processed flag back to the response-store entry in IndexedDB.

skip_network_check_if_cfr.description: Skips the generate_204 network-check request when that endpoint is client-rendered, using the browser's online status instead.

small_avatars_for_comments.description: Uses the compact avatar size in comment renderers.

small_avatars_for_comments_ep.description: Uses the compact avatar size for the comments shown inside the engagement panel.

smarter_ve_dedupping.description: Compares recurring client visual elements field by field before treating them as duplicates.

start_client_gcf.description: Enables the client-side Google Config Fetch client, which periodically pulls remote config/flag updates at runtime and attaches the resulting config hashes to outgoing requests.

state_tags_killswitch.description: Disables the state-tag cache logic that evicts cached responses when a relevant state tag changes.

submit_button_forms_api_killswitch.description: Disables submitting forms through the Forms API and falls back to the legacy submit command path.

sunnydom_native_scoped_query_selectors.description: Runs scoped querySelector/querySelectorAll against the element itself rather than its shadow root.

suppress_error_204_logging.description: Suppresses the beacon-style error report sent to the /logerror endpoint; errors are then only reported through the GEL path.

throw_err_when_logevent_malformed_killsw.description: Disables aborting a log batch when a malformed log event is found; the batch is sent without that event instead.

transport_use_scheduler.description: Routes logging-transport timers through the shared scheduler instead of plain setTimeout.

tvhtml5_logging_max_batch.description: Maximum number of queued log events before a batch is flushed immediately (default 100).

tvhtml5_logging_max_batch_ads_fork.description: Fork of the max-batch threshold for ads logging; when set it overrides the general max-batch value (default 100).

tvhtml5_use_rta_manager_for_async.description: Routes runAttestation commands through the newer async RTA manager when it is available.

universal_csi_network_ticks.description: Records CSI network ticks for requests by matching their URL against a known tick table.

unplugged_web_disable_actions_for_cec_en.description: Disables the special-case handling of the unplugged client-entity command endpoint so those actions fall through to normal navigation.

unsplit_gel_payloads_in_logs.description: Marks outgoing GEL log requests so their payloads are kept unsplit in server-side logs.

use_ajax_fetch_for_h5_logging_urls.description: Sends H5 ad-ping logging URLs via fetch() instead of image-beacon requests.

use_command_context_force_click_logging_.description: Stops forcing click logging on commands dispatched from interaction handlers.

use_error_suppression.description: Uses the server-provided SUPPRESS_CLIENT_ERRORS config to decide which noisy client errors are dropped, instead of the built-in browser-version heuristic.

use_event_time_ms_header.description: Adds an X-Goog-Event-Time header (epoch milliseconds) to logged network requests.

use_fifo_for_networkless.description: Reads queued networkless log requests oldest-first instead of newest-first.

use_readonly_for_get_most_recent_by_stat.description: Forces the networkless log-store lookup to use a read-write IndexedDB transaction instead of a read-only one.

use_request_time_ms_header.description: Sends the request timestamp as an X-Goog-Request-Time header (epoch milliseconds) instead of embedding it in the request body.

use_rta_manager_for_async.description: Routes runAttestation commands through the newer async RTA manager when it is available.

visibility_lifecycles_dynamic_background.description: Adds window focus/blur handling so the app can distinguish a backgrounded document from a hidden one.

voice_search_auth_header_removal.description: Stops sending the X-Goog-AuthUser header (session index) on authenticated requests.

vss_through_gel_video_stats.description: Sends video-stats logging payloads to the video_stats endpoint instead of the generic log_event endpoint.

warm_op_csn_cleanup.description: Only attaches the client screen nonce to the request context when the request carries click-tracking params.

web_ajax_ignore_global_headers_if_set.description: Skips adding a global request header when the caller already supplied that header.

web_animated_actions.description: Enables the animated action component with its Lottie background and foreground animations.

web_animated_actions_v2.description: Second-generation variant of the animated action component; either this or the v1 flag turns the Lottie background/foreground animations on.

web_atagconfig_pointerdown.description: Also wires pointerdown handling into link navigation config, in addition to click.

web_attention_logging_enabled.description: Reports the window's width and height in points in the InnerTube client context.

web_attributed_string_deep_equal_bugfix.description: Uses a full deep-equality check when comparing attributed strings instead of only comparing content and run counts.

web_badge_shape_aria_hidden_killswitch.description: When on, badge shapes stop marking their inner icon and text as aria-hidden, so screen readers may announce that content in addition to the badge label.

web_button_icon_size_experiment.description: Enables the experiment that picks the next-gen button's icon size from the button size (12/18/24px).

web_button_mainstage_padding.description: Adds the mainstage button-height CSS class to the document root, changing button height/padding on the mainstage.

web_button_mainstage_v2.description: Uses the smaller (18px) icon for medium-size mainstage buttons instead of 24px.

web_button_or_anchor_click_logging_kills.description: Stops forcing click logging when a button or anchor dispatches its command.

web_button_or_anchor_list_item.description: Renders list items as button/anchor elements and exposes selectable ones as menu items for accessibility.

web_button_rework.description: Enables the reworked button component, which renders buttons through the new button view model; it also requires the matching config constant to be on.

web_button_rework_with_live.description: Alternative switch for the reworked button component that also covers live-stream buttons.

web_button_vm_click_client_ve_killswitch.description: Stops passing the clicked visual element along with button view-model tap commands.

web_button_vm_refactor_disabled.description: Changes how a button's disabled state is derived: it uses the view model's explicit disabled flag (or the 'disabled' state) instead of also treating the inactive state as disabled.

web_chip_redesign_color_update.description: Uses the updated chip color palette, applying different static light styles to selected and active chips.

web_cinematic_container_image_offset.description: Uses the configured right offset for the cinematic container's fade-to-theme background image instead of a fixed -80px.

web_clear_panel_on_invalidate_killswitch.description: Killswitch that stops the engagement panel's content from being cleared when its state/model is invalidated — the panel content is unregistered instead.

web_client_ve_equality_fix.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — includes the visual-element counter in the deduplication equality check so elements differing only by counter are logged as distinct.

web_close_sheet_if_same_target_killswitc.description: Killswitch for bottom-sheet same-target handling: when on, opening a sheet from the same element as the currently open sheet closes it immediately instead of deferring the open.

web_collect_offline_state.description: Collects additional offline/device state and client attestation data and attaches it to the product-feedback payload.

web_component_pruning.description: When on, components marked as pruned are no longer lazily loaded — invoking one logs a 'Pruned Component' error and returns a placeholder.

web_continuation_invalidation_killswitch.description: Killswitch for continuation invalidation grouping: when on, continuation requests stop sending the invalidation-group 'replace' sequence strategy.

web_csi_action_sampling_enabled.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — enables sample-rate-based dropping of CSI action timing ticks.

web_csi_debug_sample_enabled.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — enables weighted debug sampling of CSI timing ticks.

web_csi_disable_alt_time_performance_mar.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — stops attaching an alternate start time to the browser performance marks emitted for CSI ticks.

web_dd_iu.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — allows debug-data callbacks to be registered under arbitrary keys rather than a fixed allowlist.

web_defer_background_continuation.description: Defers loading background continuations while the tab is hidden, waiting until it becomes visible again instead of fetching immediately.

web_delhi_comment_threads.description: Enables threaded comments — collapsible replies, sub-threads and the associated reply/hide/ban actions.

web_dialog_aria_modal_killswitch.description: Killswitch that stops dialogs from being marked as ARIA modal, reverting the accessibility change.

web_dialog_utils_killswitch.description: Killswitch that reverts dialog opening to the legacy path, deriving the popup action from the view model instead of using the supplied command.

web_disable_backdrop_filter.description: Disables the backdrop-filter blur on buttons and multi-page menus.

web_disable_gel_stp_ecatcher_killswitch.description: Killswitch that stops attaching the latest server tracking params to client error reports.

web_dropdown_menu_close_on_item_tap_kill.description: Killswitch that stops a dropdown menu from closing when one of its items is tapped.

web_enable_additional_event_listener_for.description: Adds keyboard activation (Enter/Space) for buttons, links and inputs that are wired to a tap command.

web_enable_ai_search_background_navigati.description: Cancels a pending AI-search command when the page starts navigating away, so it does not fire on the new page.

web_enable_ai_search_streaming.description: Enables streaming responses for AI search continuations, so results arrive incrementally.

web_enable_arrow_key_navigation_in_dropd.description: Enables arrow-key and Tab navigation between items inside a dropdown menu.

web_enable_card_view_model_hover_effect.description: Enables the hover effect on card view models, so cards respond visually to pointer hover when they are enabled and have a renderer context.

web_enable_channel_pivot_panel.description: Skips reload-continuation handling for the channel pivot panel's header slot, so it is not rebuilt.

web_enable_command_run_tabindex_fix.description: Stops setting tabindex=0 on attributed-string links, so only genuinely focusable command elements are tabbable.

web_enable_constrained_list_layout.description: Constrains vertical list containers to a maximum width, centring them and limiting the preview width.

web_enable_course_icon_update.description: Uses the Creator Academy icon for course entries instead of the lightbulb icon.

web_enable_entity_upsert_on_update.description: Allows entity updates to insert the entity when it does not exist yet (upsert) instead of silently skipping.

web_enable_full_height_carousel_next_but.description: Renders the next button of ad-card carousels at full height.

web_enable_killswitch_for_selectable_lis.description: Killswitch for the selectable list-item tap fix: when on, Space keypresses trigger the item's click path instead of invoking its tap command.

web_enable_killswitch_for_skip_child_tag.description: Killswitch that stops the list-item keyboard handler from ignoring Enter/Space presses on nested links and buttons — with it on, the item handles those keys itself.

web_enable_killswitch_tabindex_fix.description: Killswitch for the list-item tabindex fix: when on, the earlier behaviour applies and list items that only have a tap handler still receive a tabindex.

web_enable_lifecycle_monitoring.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — emits performance marks/measures (and trace events) around component lifecycle events.

web_enable_list_item_action_typography.description: Applies the action-typography style to list-item action labels.

web_enable_modern_progress_bar_overlay.description: Uses the modern progress-bar overlay on thumbnails instead of the legacy small badge and progress-bar styling.

web_enable_player_request_captions_last_.description: Sends only the most recently selected caption language in player caption requests instead of the full language list.

web_enable_renderer_logger.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — routes rendered component information to a renderer logger.

web_enable_request_key_killswitch.description: Killswitch for request-key handling: when on, requests also fall back to the legacy stored request key rather than only using the key from command metadata.

web_enable_retries.description: Enables automatic retries for network requests, including requests that do not declare a retry strategy.

web_enable_rive_animated_like_icon.description: Renders the like button animation with Rive (WebAssembly) instead of the Lottie animation.

web_enable_safari_button_tabindex_fix.description: Gives buttons a tabindex of 0 in Safari so they can receive keyboard focus.

web_enable_typography_bump.description: Applies the v1 enlarged typography scale to lockups and rich grids instead of the legacy text styles.

web_enable_typography_bump_v2.description: Applies the second-generation typography scale to feed-ad metadata headlines, layered on top of the v1 bump.

web_enable_voting_animation.description: Enables the animated voting experience — animated vote counts and the voting animation events fired after list updates.

web_enable_wrapper_for_cow_component_in_.description: Wraps the popup's content in an extra container element before it is slotted into the popup.

web_exclusive_hover_killswitch.description: Killswitch that disables the exclusive hover effect on cards and list items, falling back to the legacy hover styling.

web_fi_listen_disable_bound_fn_helper.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — binds event listeners with a fresh bound handler instead of the cached bound-function helper.

web_fix_rolling_numbers_zoom_safari.description: Fixes rolling-number animations on zoomed Safari pages by measuring the rendered character height and using it as the animation margin.

web_flexible_menu_improvement_killswitch.description: Killswitch that reverts the flexible-menu overflow/resize handling to the legacy width-tracking behaviour.

web_flexible_menu_logging_rate_limit.description: Sampling probability (0–1) for rate-limited logging of excessive flexible-menu update warnings; 0 disables the warning.

web_forward_suggest_stats_killswitch.description: Killswitch that stops forwarding search-box suggestion stats with the search request.

web_fp_via_jspb.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — sends batched client logs (including the final payload) as protobuf instead of JSON.

web_fp_via_jspb_and_json.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — sends the final payload in both protobuf and JSON form.

web_gcf_hashes_innertube.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — includes the cold/hot config and hash data in the request client context.

web_gel_sequence_info_killswitch.description: Killswitch that stops attaching sequence-group info (index and group key) to logged events.

web_gel_timeout_cap.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — caps how long log batches can stay queued by forcing a flush after a maximum timeout.

web_global_dep_injector_killswitch.description: Killswitch that stops the dependency injector from being exposed as a shared global instance.

web_horizontal_shelf_imp_thumbnail_borde.description: Enables dynamic border rounding on horizontal-shelf thumbnails for inline playback.

web_horizontal_shelf_resize_fix.description: Enables the horizontal-shelf resize fix, recomputing the shelf layout when it changes size.

web_image_load_telemetry.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — tracks image load/error events and downloaded bytes for thumbnail-load telemetry.

web_include_cow_tracing.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — enables performance tracing in the component rendering runtime.

web_inline_expander_child_tap_kill_switc.description: Killswitch that stops taps on buttons/links inside an inline expander's body from being ignored — with it on, any tap toggles the expander.

web_it_context_set_original_url_ks.description: Killswitch that stops setting the original page URL on the request context.

web_layout_system_update.description: Switches responsive layout to the updated system — a 600px compact breakpoint, revised margins/gutters and a minimum of two columns for wide grids.

web_lifecycle_error_handling_killswitch.description: Killswitch that removes error handling around component lifecycle callbacks, letting their errors propagate uncaught.

web_linear_gradient_killswitch.description: Killswitch that disables the gradient placeholder rendered behind images while they load.

web_list_item_duplicate_command_killswit.description: Killswitch for duplicate list-item commands: when on, a list item without its own tap handler dispatches the command from its renderer context directly.

web_list_item_flat_button_label_killswit.description: Killswitch that reverts list-item labelling: when on, an aria-label is always set even when the item already shows a visible text label.

web_live_chat_available_bugfix.description: Starts the live chat engagement panel collapsed by default (bugfix for live chat availability).

web_lockup_view_model_compact_padding_up.description: Applies the updated compact padding to lockups rendered in compact layout.

web_log_browse_ticks_ks.description: Killswitch that stops tagging browse requests with the browse request/response tick markers used for latency logging.

web_log_cfg_cee_ks.description: Killswitch that disables logging of client experiment events.

web_log_effective_connection_type.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — sends the device's effective connection type with request client info.

web_log_memory_total_kbytes.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — sends the device's total memory (in kilobytes) with request client info.

web_log_player_watch_next_ticks.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — tags watch-next player requests with request/response tick markers.

web_log_reels_ticks.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — tags reels watch requests with request/response tick markers.

web_log_search_ticks_ks.description: Killswitch that stops tagging search requests with the search request/response tick markers.

web_logging_max_batch.description: Maximum number of queued log events before a batch is flushed to the logging endpoint (defaults to 100 when unset).

web_lr_app_quality_killswitch.description: Killswitch that stops adding the Living Room app quality value to the TV client's request info.

web_modern_badge_shape.description: Forces badges to use the modern badge shape.

web_modern_badge_view_model.description: Marks badge view models as modern, enabling the newer badge rendering (explicit and rating badge types).

web_modern_buttons.description: Enables the modern button styling across surfaces — filled, mono and segmented button overrides for comment, reply and submit buttons.

web_monomer_web_component_wrapper_handle.description: Wraps web-component rendering in error handling so render failures are caught and reported instead of crashing the page.

web_move_popups_to_fullscreen.description: Moves open popups into the fullscreen element while the page is in fullscreen, keeping them visible.

web_nm_error_passthrough_ks.description: Killswitch that stops the network layer from logging errors when InnerTube commands or requests fail.

web_nm_fetch_chunk_callback_ks.description: Killswitch for the fetch-chunk callback: when on, the fetch step returns the raw response instead of the callback-modified one.

web_no_lock_on_touchstart_killswitch.description: Killswitch that makes overlay scroll-locking also react to touchstart/touchmove, restoring the earlier touch scroll-lock behaviour.

web_no_tracking_params_in_shell_killswit.description: Killswitch that keeps the shell's click-tracking parameters in the request context instead of stripping them.

web_payload_policy_disabled_killswitch.description: Killswitch for the server payload policy: when on, log-event payloads that the policy marks as disabled are still sent instead of being dropped.

web_ping_disable_scrub_referrer.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — sends ping/beacon requests without scrubbing the referrer.

web_pip_minimize_breakages.description: Downgrades ShadyDOM dispatch errors so they no longer count as reportable breakages, cutting error noise caused by picture-in-picture.

web_playback_associated_log_ctt.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — attaches click-tracking token auth info to the playback-associated log event.

web_playback_associated_ve.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — attaches visual-element tracking info to the playback-associated log event.

web_player_error_message_reason_as_forma.description: Killswitch: when on, the player error message's reason is rendered as plain text instead of a rich formatted string.

web_player_sentinel_yt_experiments_sync.description: Sentinel flag read independently by the page and the player; any mismatch between the two values is reported as an experiment-sync error.

web_playlist_panel_default_collapsed.description: The playlist/queue panel starts collapsed by default instead of open.

web_populate_client_screen_killswitch.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — stops including the client screen value in the request context.

web_populate_internal_geo_killswitch.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — stops including the internal country code in the request context.

web_populate_time_zone_itc_killswitch.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — stops including the client time zone in the request context.

web_popup_cache_key_killswitch.description: Killswitch for popup reuse caching: when on, the cache key combines the popup action id with the target element; when off, only the target is used.

web_prequest_context_killswitch.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — stops attaching the external pre-request context to outgoing request payloads.

web_process_response_store_responses.description: When on, responses served from the response cache are run through response processing again instead of being returned raw.

web_propagate_is_pressed_killswitch.description: Killswitch: when on, a button's pressed state is taken only from its selected state instead of also propagating an externally supplied pressed value.

web_reload_continuation_items_command_re.description: Killswitch: when on, reload-continuation items no longer resolve their embedded command through the command handler before loading.

web_remix_allow_up_to_3x_playback_rate.description: Adds 2.5x and 3x options to the playback-speed menu.

web_remove_snackbar_actions.description: Removes the action button and the default close button from toast/snackbar notifications.

web_remove_web_navigation_endpoint_data.description: Removes the navigation-endpoint data fallback when resolving link URLs, so only the command-metadata URL is used.

web_replace_formatted_with_attributed_st.description: Renders text through yt-attributed-string instead of yt-formatted-string, falling back to the formatted-string renderer when the text has special runs.

web_responsive_current.description: Selects the newer column-count formula for extra-compact responsive grids, changing how many columns the grid shows at a given width.

web_responsive_extra_compact_2x.description: Makes extra-compact responsive grids use twice the standard column unit, widening the column count.

web_sanitize_request_init_ks.description: Killswitch: when on, request init options are passed through as-is instead of being sanitized before the fetch request is constructed.

web_selectable_item_child_tap_kill_switc.description: Killswitch: when on, the child-tap guard is bypassed so tapping a nested element inside a selectable item still toggles its selection.

web_send_vss3_isolated_payload.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — sends VSS3 video-stats payloads as isolated log payloads instead of batching them.

web_share_dialog_touch_scroll.description: Enables touch scrolling in the share dialog's list of share targets.

web_sharing_embed_preview_killswitch.description: Killswitch controlling how the share dialog's embed preview is created: when on, the iframe is injected as an HTML string; when off, it is built with DOM APIs.

web_shorts_prefetch_service_enabled.description: Enables prefetching the Shorts player response ahead of playback.

web_show_ep_endpoint_response_received.description: Registers the endpoint's response-received command so the client acts on the response when it arrives.

web_side_rail_dismissible_panels.description: Makes the watch-page side-rail panels use the grid-view layout regardless of the responsive conditions that normally enable it.

web_skip_impression_click_killswitch.description: Killswitch: when on, click tracking is still sent for interactions flagged as impression-only (the impression-click suppression is disabled).

web_skip_missing_vimio_observer.description: Reports an error when a visibility observer is missing instead of silently skipping that element's visibility tracking.

web_stateless_chip_button_role_killswitc.description: Killswitch: when on, stateless chips use the tab ARIA role instead of the button role.

web_store_entry_preserve_framework_updat.description: Preserves the framework-updates data in cached response-store entries that have already been processed, instead of always stripping it.

web_supports_animations_api.description: Enables using the Web Animations API for button and view-model animations.

web_tag_automated_log_events.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — adds the automated-log-event source to the context of logged events.

web_toast_to_snackbar_migration.description: Migrates toast notifications to the snackbar rendering path, reading the text from the notification-action, overlay-toast or overlay-message renderers.

web_toggle_button_force_update_killswitc.description: Killswitch: when on, toggling a toggle button no longer forces a data-binding refresh of the toggled state.

web_use_cache_for_image_fallback.description: On image load failure, retries the image from the cache as an object URL before falling back to the placeholder.

web_use_resolve_command_for_service_endp.description: Killswitch: when on, service-endpoint commands in dropdowns are dispatched directly instead of being resolved as commands first.

web_vss_routing_check_all_tier_policies.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — when tiered logging is on, checks all tier policies to decide whether video-stats logging is used.

web_watch_cinematics_disabled_by_default.description: Disables watch-page cinematics (the animated background) by default.

web_watch_cinematics_preferred_reduced_m.description: Disables watch-page cinematics by default for users who prefer reduced motion.

web_watch_compact_comments.description: Enables the compact comments layout on the watch page, with narrower comments sized for optimal reading width.

web_watch_compact_comments_header.description: Uses the compact header layout for the watch-page comments section.

web_watch_flex_menu_one_raf_killswitch.description: Killswitch: when on, the flex menu no longer cancels a pending animation-frame update, so layout updates may schedule multiple frames instead of one.

web_watch_hero_list_3_line_title_height_.description: Numeric height threshold (in pixels) above which a hero-list lockup title is allowed to wrap to three lines; defaults to 100.

web_yt_icon_update_styles_killswitch.description: Killswitch: when on, yt-icon no longer applies explicit width/height styles, leaving icon sizing to CSS.

wil_icon_load_immediately.description: Loads icons immediately instead of deferring the fetch until the next animation frame.

wil_icon_network_first.description: Uses a network-first strategy for icon loading, trying the network before the cache.

wil_icon_render_when_idle.description: Defers icon rendering until the browser is idle.

wil_icon_use_mask_rendering.description: Renders icons via CSS mask mode instead of the default rendering mode.

wil_icons_cache_purge_killswitch.description: Killswitch: when on, the icon cache is never purged (the periodic yt-icons cache cleanup is skipped).

wiz_enable_metadata_extraction_killswitc.description: Killswitch: when on, error reports stop extracting rich component metadata (tag name, owner trace, severity) and include only the component stack.

wiz_next_client_ve_parent_fix.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — resolves the nearest parent visual element through the component tree and renderer-context logging directives instead of the DOM parent.

woffle_render_failed_download_state_ks.description: Killswitch: when on, videos whose download state is FAILED are no longer treated as renderable/downloadable.

wrap_content_metadata_to_second_line.description: Wraps a lockup's metadata to a second line when it has multiple metadata parts instead of keeping it on one line.

wug_networking_gzip_request.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — gzips request bodies before sending network requests.

yf_formatted_string_service_endpoint_kil.description: Killswitch: when on, links whose endpoint is a service endpoint are rendered as ordinary links instead of being handled by the service-endpoint click handler.

youtube_web_csi_ticks_migration.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — sends the migrated numeric tick id instead of the tick name in latency (CSI) logging.

yt_badge_supported_renderer_ks.description: Killswitch: when on, computed metadata badges are written to the legacy computed property instead of the copy-on-write property.

yt_img_shadow_trigger_show_on_visible.description: Triggers image loading when the image element becomes visible, instead of only on prescan/attach.

yt_iron_overlay_click_tap_killswitch_v2.description: Killswitch: when on, the overlay closes on the 'tap' event only, without the deduplicated click listener.

ytidb_async_stack_killswitch.description: Killswitch: when on, async stack traces are not appended to ytidb database errors before they are reported.

ytidb_clear_music_killswitch.description: Killswitch: when on, the ytidb cache-clearing job that runs at startup is skipped.

ytidb_clear_optimizations_killswitch.description: Killswitch: when on, the ytidb clear job skips its early-exit optimizations and always runs the full cache clear when the network is available.

ytmwi_force_media_client_app_upgrade_err.description: Forces the media-client app-upgrade-required error to be shown regardless of the actual client version.

ytpopup_close_sibling_popups_killswitch.description: Killswitch: when on, opening a popup no longer closes other open popups that share the same position target.
