ytpopup_disable_cache_allowlist.description: When default popup caching is disabled, controls which popups are removed on close: on = only those on the explicit no-cache list; off = any view-model-based popup.

ytpopup_disable_default_html_caching.description: Disables default HTML caching for popups, so popup content is removed or rebuilt when closed rather than reused.

ytwiz_enable_debug_component_props.description: Exposes debug properties (resolved component inputs) on wiz-rendered elements for developer inspection.

action_companion_center_align_descriptio.description: Center-aligns the description text inside the action-companion component.

all_web_enable_network_machine.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — enables the unified web network machine (shared request layer) on all web surfaces.

allow_skip_networkless.description: Allows playback pings to skip the networkless transport and be sent over the regular network.

cow_optimize_idom_compat.description: Enables the copy-on-write optimization for incremental-DOM compatibility.

csi_on_gel.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — routes client-side latency (CSI) instrumentation through GEL logging.

dedupping_server_ve.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — de-duplicates server-provided visual-element tracking entries.

disable_av_switcher_when_audio_only.description: Hides the audio/video switcher while the player is in audio-only mode.

disable_pacf_logging_for_memory_limited_.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect — turns off PACF logging on memory-constrained TV devices.

embeds_desktop_enable_volume_slider.description: Shows a volume slider in embedded desktop players.

enable_active_view_display_ad_renderer_w.description: Enables rendering display (active-view) ad renderers on the web home feed.

enable_ai_disclosure_for_compact_landsca.description: Shows the AI-content disclosure notice in the compact landscape layout (image variant) on web.
Innertube-side counterpart: enables the AI-content disclosure notice for the compact landscape layout's image variant via the Innertube response.

enable_ai_disclosure_for_text_image_no_b.description: Shows the buttonless AI-content disclosure notice for the text-and-image treatment on web.
Shows the AI-generated content disclosure on text-and-image cards that have no action button.

enable_ai_disclosure_for_top_landscape_i.description: Shows the AI-generated content disclosure on the top landscape image banner.
Shows the AI-generated content disclosure on the top landscape image banner.

enable_ai_disclosure_for_video_display_b.description: Shows the AI-generated content disclosure on the buttoned video billboard layout.
Shows the AI-generated content disclosure on the buttoned video billboard layout.
Shows the AI-generated content disclosure on the video layout with a button group.
Shows the AI-generated content disclosure on the video layout with a button group.

enable_ai_disclosure_for_video_display_c.description: Shows the AI-generated content disclosure on the compact video layout with a button group.
Shows the AI-generated content disclosure on the compact video layout with a button group.
Shows the AI-generated content disclosure on the buttoned compact video layout.
Shows the AI-generated content disclosure on the buttoned compact video layout.
Shows the AI-generated content disclosure on the compact video carousel with a button group.

Shows the AI-generated content disclosure on the compact video layout.

enable_ai_disclosure_for_video_display_f.description: Shows the AI-generated content disclosure on the full video layout.
Shows the AI-generated content disclosure on the full video layout.

enable_attention_logging_measure_on_show.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Records attention measurements when an element becomes visible.

enable_automotive_form_factor_check.description: Enables a check for the automotive (car head-unit) form factor, used to adapt behavior on car devices.

enable_continuations_migration_playlist_.description: Migrates the playlist shelf to the updated continuations (pagination) format.

enable_dai_sdf_h5_preroll.description: Enables server-driven (SDF) preroll ads for dynamically inserted ads (DAI) on the web player.

enable_datasync_id_header_in_web_vss_pin.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Sends the DataSync ID header on web video-playback statistics pings.

enable_default_mono_cta_migration_web_cl.description: Switches the ad endcap (action interstitial) call-to-action button to the monochrome 'mono' styling variant, including the unified endcap layout.

enable_endemic_high_ccv_smearing_h5.description: Spreads (smears) the ad prefetch window for high-concurrency live streams using a randomized offset, so requests are not fired at the same instant by every viewer.

enable_guide_user_profile_web_support.description: Shows the user profile entry in the web guide (side navigation).

enable_inline_muted_playback_on_web_sear.description: Inline muted (preview) playback on search results.
Extends inline muted (preview) playback on search results to the compact video card layout.
Extends inline muted (preview) playback on search results to the compact buttoned video card layout.

enable_is_extended_monitoring.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Enables extended client monitoring.

enable_ltc_param_fetch_from_innertube.description: Adds live-stream playback position details (current time, media time, segment index) to the ad-break context.

enable_modular_player_page_server.description: Enables the modular, server-rendered player page.

enable_music_mweb_profile_menu_app_insta.description: Adds an 'Install app' entry to the profile menu on YouTube Music mobile web.

enable_music_mweb_side_nav_app_install_e.description: Adds an 'Install app' entry to the side navigation on YouTube Music mobile web.

enable_music_web_bauhaus_album_detail_pa.description: Bauhaus redesign of the album detail page.

enable_music_web_bauhaus_detail_pages_re.description: Bauhaus download buttons on detail pages.

enable_music_web_bauhaus_playlist_detail.description: Bauhaus redesign of the playlist detail page.

enable_music_web_cairo_voting.description: Enables the voting control in the Cairo UI redesign.

enable_music_web_cairo_voting_refresh_to.description: Shows a toast after the Cairo voting control refreshes.

enable_names_handles_account_switcher.description: Shows YouTube handles alongside names in the account switcher.

enable_pause_ads_on_ytv_html5.description: Enables pause ads (shown while playback is paused) on the YouTube TV HTML5 player.

enable_sdf_dai_h5_midroll.description: Enables server-driven (SDF) midroll ads for dynamically inserted ads (DAI) on the web player.

enable_sdf_h5_endemic_mid_post_roll.description: Enables server-driven (SDF) midroll and post-roll ads on the web player for standard content.

enable_sdf_on_h5_unplugged_vod_midroll.description: Enables server-driven (SDF) midroll ads for unplugged VOD on the web player.

enable_sdf_shorts_player_bytes_h5.description: Enables server-driven (SDF) ad player bytes in the Shorts player on web.

enable_session_replay_mask_backgrounds.description: Masks element backgrounds when capturing session-replay recordings.

enable_smearing_expansion_dai.description: Expands request smearing for dynamically inserted ads (DAI) to spread load instead of firing all requests at once.

enable_video_display_compact_button_grou.description: Uses the compact video layout with a button group in desktop search results.

enable_web_home_top_landscape_image_layo.description: Makes the whole top landscape image banner on the web home page clickable.

export_networkless_options.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Exports the client's networkless (offline) option set.

h5_companion_enable_adcpn_macro_substitu.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Substitutes the AD_CPN macro with the client playback nonce in companion-ad click pings.

h5_enable_premium_ads_seen_adding_host_c.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Adds the host content playback nonce to premium 'ads seen' client logging.

h5_inplayer_enable_adcpn_macro_substitut.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Substitutes the AD_CPN macro with the client playback nonce in in-player ad click pings.

h5_reset_cache_and_filter_before_update_.description: Clears the cache and applies filters before refreshing the masthead banner.

high_ccv_client_side_caching_h5.description: Enables client-side caching for high-concurrency (high CCV) live streams.

html5_disable_airplay_button_for_mweb.description: Hides AirPlay button on mobile web.

html5_log_trigger_events_with_debug_data.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Includes debug data on logged trigger events.

html5_ssdai_enable_media_end_cue_range.description: Enables media-end cue range handling for server-stitched dynamic ad insertion (SS DAI) playback.

log_click_with_layer_from_element_in_com.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Logs clicks together with the UI layer of the clicked element.

music_enable_explore_tab_on_web.description: Explore tab in the side nav.

music_enable_responsive_radio.description: Responsive radio (autoplay chain steering) — server side.

music_web_cast_set_initial_state.description: Sets the initial playback state when a cast session starts from the web player.

music_web_delay_watch_next_processing.description: Delays processing of watch-next (up-next) queue items.

music_web_enable_add_to_library_explicit.description: Adds an explicit-content toggle to the add-to-library flow.

music_web_enable_autoscroll_to_center.description: Auto-scrolls the current or selected item to the center of the view.

music_web_enable_av_switcher.description: Audio/video quality switcher in the player bar.

music_web_enable_capri_redesign.description: Capri redesign of the YTM UI.

music_web_enable_clear_search_history.description: Adds a control to clear the search history.

music_web_enable_clear_watch_history_ref.description: Refreshes the UI after the watch history is cleared.

music_web_enable_player_page_layout_fixe.description: Applies layout fixes to the player page.

music_web_enable_reorder_controller.description: Enables drag-to-reorder for queue and playlist items.

music_web_enable_reuse_player_queue_item.description: Reuses the existing player queue item component when the queue updates instead of rebuilding it.

music_web_ping_ad_start.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Sends a ping when an ad starts.

music_web_respect_playback_content_mode.description: Honors the current playback content mode (e.g. audio-only vs video) during playback.

mweb_enable_click_to_play_pause.description: Tapping the video area on mobile web toggles play/pause instead of just revealing the controls.

mweb_enable_fine_scrubbing_for_recs.description: Allows fine-grained scrubbing (small seek steps) when dragging the progress bar on the mobile-web player.

mweb_fix_cinematic_fullscreen_leak.description: Fixes a state/memory leak that occurs when toggling cinematic fullscreen mode on mobile web.

mweb_player_control_on_hover.description: Shows the player controls when hovering over the player on mobile web (pointer/hover-capable devices).

mweb_progress_bar_seek_on_mouse_click.description: Clicking a position on the progress bar seeks to that position on mobile web.

mweb_shorts_comments_panel_id_change.description: Uses a different element id for the Shorts comments panel on mobile web.

mweb_use_microformat_title_for_posts.description: Uses the post's microformat (metadata) title on mobile web instead of the rendered on-screen title.

player_controls_volume_controls_use_play.description: Player volume controls read their state directly from the player's props rather than a separate source.

polymer_verifiy_app_state.description: Enables extra verification of the Polymer app's internal state (debug aid).

qoe_send_and_write.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Controls whether QOE playback-quality pings are both written and sent.

remove_chevron_from_ad_disclosure_banner.description: Removes the chevron icon from the ad disclosure banner in the H5 player.

remove_masthead_channel_banner_on_refres.description: Removes the channel masthead banner when the page is refreshed.

remove_slot_id_exited_trigger_for_dai_in.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Stops emitting the slot-id 'exited' trigger when a DAI ad slot in the player expires.

stop_handling_click_for_non_rendering_ov.description: Stops the ad overlay from handling click actions for layouts that are no longer being rendered.

use_session_based_sampling.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Makes telemetry sampling decisions per session instead of per event.

vss_final_ping_send_and_write.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Controls whether the final video-streaming-stats (VSS) ping is both written and sent.

vss_playback_use_send_and_write.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Controls whether playback video-streaming-stats (VSS) pings are both written and sent.

web_api_url.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Selects the web API URL endpoint used for requests.

web_attention_logging_export_to_gel.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Exports attention (viewer engagement) logging through the GEL logging pipeline.

web_dedupe_ve_grafting.description: Prevents duplicate visual-element (VE) grafting when logging element impressions.

web_disable_chip_view_model_mutation.description: Stops the chip component from mutating its view model in place.

web_enable_error_204.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Reports compression-related request failures (empty/204-style responses) through the error handler.

web_enable_list_item_button_menuitem.description: Renders tappable list items as real button/anchor elements with menuitem semantics instead of plain containers.

web_ensure_monotonic_history_timestamps.description: Forces navigation-history timestamps to always increase, preventing out-of-order entries from being recorded.

web_fix_command_context_visibility_reobs.description: Fixes command-context visibility tracking by re-observing elements when their context changes.

web_fix_reused_component_impression_logg.description: Corrects impression logging for recycled/reused components so impressions aren't miscounted.

web_hide_your_data_on_automotive.description: Hides the 'Your data in YouTube' entry point in the automotive/car interface.

web_linear_layout_with_container_layout.description: Renders the linear layout using the container-layout implementation.

web_non_navigating_atag.description: Renders anchors as non-navigating elements so clicks are handled by the app instead of triggering a page load.

web_overlay_reactive_render.description: Makes the overlay component re-render reactively when its state changes.

web_prefetch_preload_video.description: Prefetches and preloads video data to speed up playback start.

web_progress_bar_draggable.description: Makes the player progress bar draggable so it can be scrubbed.

web_propagate_visibility_to_application_.description: Propagates element visibility changes into the app's global application state.

web_shorts_fix_sticker_metadata_collisio.description: Fixes a metadata collision between stickers in Shorts so overlapping stickers render correctly.

web_unified_fetch.description: Routes network requests through a single unified fetch implementation.

web_video_preview_sparkles_click_locatio.description: Adds a helper that computes the correct click location for the sparkles overlay on video previews.

webpo_exit_on_net_err.description: Causes the web player to bail out on a network error instead of continuing.

wiz_diff_overwritable.description: Allows wiz render diffs to be overwritten so later updates can replace earlier ones.

yt_iron_overlay_click_tap_killswitch.description: Killswitch: when on, disables iron-overlay click/tap handling, reverting to the previous overlay behavior.

H5_async_logging_delay_ms.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Delay in milliseconds before buffered async logs are flushed.

log_window_onerror_fraction.description: Fraction (0-1) of window.onerror events that are sampled and reported; the rest are dropped.

web_attention_logging_scroll_throttle.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Throttle interval in milliseconds between scroll events sampled for attention logging.

web_load_prediction_threshold.description: Probability threshold (0-1) controlling when load prediction triggers a preload of the predicted resource.

web_navigation_prediction_threshold.description: Probability threshold (0-1) controlling when navigation prediction preloads the page the user is predicted to visit next.

web_session_replay_sample_rate.description: Fraction (0-1) of sessions that are recorded and uploaded for session replay.

web_tracing_sample_rate.description: Fraction (0-1) of sessions for which tracing data is captured.

ytidb_transaction_ended_event_rate_limit.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Maximum rate at which ytidb transaction-ended telemetry events are emitted.

botguard_async_snapshot_timeout_ms.description: Timeout in milliseconds to wait for an async BotGuard snapshot before the request fails.

check_navigator_accuracy_timeout_ms.description: Timeout in milliseconds allowed for the navigator-accuracy check.

client_streamz_web_flush_count.description: Maximum number of client Streamz logging invocations buffered before a flush is forced; -1 disables the limit.

client_streamz_web_flush_interval_second.description: Interval in seconds between flushes of client Streamz metrics.

compression_disable_point.description: Threshold at which request-body compression gets disabled.

custom_active_view_tos_timeout_ms.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Timeout in milliseconds for the custom active-view time-on-screen (TOS) measurement.

endemic_high_ccv_smearing_max_window_sec.description: Maximum window, in seconds, over which prefetch timing is randomly smeared for endemic high-concurrency livestreams.

gel_queue_timeout_max_ms.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Maximum time in milliseconds a queued GEL log batch may wait before being sent.

h5_fetch_ad_pings_initial_delay_ms.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Initial delay in milliseconds before retrying failed ad-ping fetch requests.

h5_fetch_ad_pings_max_retries.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Maximum number of retries for failed ad-ping fetch requests.

initial_gel_batch_timeout.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Timeout in milliseconds before the first GEL log batch is flushed.

max_body_size_to_compress.description: Maximum request-body size in bytes that is still gzip-compressed; larger bodies are sent uncompressed.

max_prefetch_window_sec_for_livestream_o.description: Maximum prefetch window, in seconds, used when optimizing livestream playback.

min_prefetch_offset_sec_for_livestream_o.description: Minimum offset, in seconds, before the playback position at which livestream prefetching starts.

music_web_canary_stage.description: Numeric canary rollout stage for the music web client.

music_web_delay_watch_next_ms.description: Delay in milliseconds before the watch-next action is processed.

music_web_list_continuation_prescan_heig.description: Distance in pixels from the end of the list at which the next continuation page is pre-scanned and loaded.

music_web_session_check_interval_millis.description: Interval in milliseconds between checks that the user's session is still valid (with randomized jitter).

network_polling_interval.description: Interval in milliseconds between network connectivity polling checks.

slow_compressions_before_abandon_count.description: Number of slow compressions tolerated before request-body compression is abandoned.

translate_button_style_on_web.description: Selects which visual style variant is used for the translate button on web.

web_ai_search_streaming_request_bloat_by.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Extra byte padding added to AI search streaming requests.

web_foreground_heartbeat_interval_ms.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Interval in milliseconds between foreground heartbeats sent to the server.

web_gel_debounce_ms.description: Logging/network plumbing only, no UI effect. Debounce window in milliseconds before queued GEL log batches are sent.

web_max_tracing_events.description: Maximum number of tracing events retained in the trace buffer.

web_session_replay_mousemove_interval.description: Sampling interval for mouse-move events captured during session replay.

web_session_replay_scroll_interval.description: Sampling interval for scroll events captured during session replay.

web_session_replay_send_after_timeout.description: Timeout after which buffered session-replay data is uploaded.

web_tracing_session_replay.description: Enables recording of session-replay data as part of tracing.

wil_icon_max_concurrent_fetches.description: Maximum number of icon fetches that may run concurrently.

ytcsi_debug_max_size.description: Maximum number of entries kept in the ytcsi debug array; older entries are dropped beyond this.

ytidb_remake_db_retries.description: How many times the ytidb IndexedDB may be deleted and recreated when expected object stores are missing.

ytidb_reopen_db_retries.description: How many times the ytidb IndexedDB may be reopened when expected object stores are missing.

debug_forced_promo_id.description: Forces a specific promo id to be used, for debugging promo rendering.

user_preference_collection_initial_brows.description: Browse id opened as the initial page of the user-preference (tastebuilder) collection flow.

web_client_version_override.description: Overrides the client version string sent to the server.

web_op_signal_type_banlist.description: List of signal types that are blocked from being sent as web operation signals.

web_tracing_enabled_spans.description: List of span types included in tracing output.
